name: Manhattan Village
description: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air shopping destination in the heart of Manhattan Beach, featuring premium retailers, contemporary fashion brands, and refined dining options. This sophisticated lifestyle center combines a coastal-modern aesthetic with convenient access to the affluent South Bay beach communities. With its thoughtfully curated tenant mix and resort-like atmosphere, Manhattan Village offers an elevated shopping experience tailored to discerning beach-town residents and visitors.
demographics: Manhattan Village attracts an affluent demographic from the South Bay area, with visitors predominantly consisting of upper-middle-class families, professionals aged 30-65, and fashion-conscious millennials with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area encompasses the wealthy beach communities of Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and El Segundo, drawing sophisticated shoppers who value quality over quantity and prefer a curated retail experience. Typical visitors exhibit strong preferences for contemporary fashion, beauty products, and experiential dining, with shopping patterns characterized by frequent visits for both destination purchases and lifestyle browsing.
summary: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air lifestyle center serving Manhattan Beach's affluent coastal community with premium retailers and sophisticated dining options.
